verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-export feature, open export formats, or exit/offboarding path for BigCommerce. The REST/GraphQL management APIs are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own export, which earns no credit. The 'Switch from Shopify...' claim describes migrating into the platform, not out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
